description: This file defines the vt_DateTime class, which manages date and time operations such as constructing date objects, retrieving formatted dates/times, and calculating date adjustments within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: vt_DateTime
classes.description: A class for handling date and time operations, including construction, formatting, and date calculations.

methods.name: vt_DateTime
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date object based on provided array of date/time components or timestamp.

methods.name: getTodayDatetimebyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object for a specific hour of the day based on index.

methods.name: getThisweekDaysbyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object for a specific day of the week based on index.

methods.name: getThismonthDaysbyIndex
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a date in the current month by index; recommends using getThisMonthsDayByIndex.

methods.name: getThisyearMonthsbyIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object for a specific month in the current year based on index.

methods.name: getHourendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing the end of the current hour.

methods.name: getDayendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing the end of the current day.

methods.name: getMonthendtime
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object representing the end of the current month.

methods.name: get_Date
methods.description: Returns the day of the week as a string.

methods.name: getmonthName_inshort
methods.description: Returns the short name of the month.

methods.name: getMonth
methods.description: Returns the month number.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the current month.

methods.name: getmonthName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the month.

methods.name: getdayofWeek
methods.description: Returns the full name of the day of the week.

methods.name: getdayofWeek_inshort
methods.description: Returns the short name of the day of the week.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets the date/time based on a timestamp, updating internal properties.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the date/time components from the object and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: get_formatted_date
methods.description: Returns the date formatted for user display.

methods.name: get_DB_formatted_date
methods.description: Returns the date in database format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: get_formatted_time
methods.description: Returns the time in HH:MM format.

methods.name: get_changed_day
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the previous or next day.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_week
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the start of the previous or next week.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_month
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the first day of the previous or next month.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_changed_year
methods.description: Returns a new vt_DateTime object for the previous or next year.

methods.name: get_date_str
methods.description: Returns a string representing the date components.

methods.name: getThisMonthsDayByIndex
methods.description: Returns a vt_DateTime object for a specific day in the current month based on index.
